mapper.sql: (t.received_amount > 0 OR t.invoice_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_invoice invoice WHERE invoice.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND invoice.receivable_id = t.receivable_id AND invoice.deleted = 0) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_deal_team team WHERE team.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND team.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND team.biz_id = t.receivable_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_deal_event event WHERE event.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND event.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND event.biz_id = t.receivable_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_approval approval WHERE approval.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND approval.business_ref_type = 'CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND approval.business_ref_id = t.receivable_id AND approval.deleted = 0)) AS binding_locked
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_receivable WHERE receivable_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT receivable.*, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_receivable receivable JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = receivable.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = receivable.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 WHERE receivable.receivable_id = #{id} AND receivable.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND receivable.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_receivable SET customer_id = #{record.customerId}, customer_name = #{record.customerName}, contract_id = #{record.contractId}, contract_no = #{record.contractNo}, receivable_name = #{record.receivableName}, planned_amount = #{record.plannedAmount}, outstanding_amount = #{record.outstandingAmount}, status = #{record.status}, owner_id = #{record.ownerId}, owner_name = #{record.ownerName}, due_date = #{record.dueDate}, remark = #{record.remark}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} WHERE receivable_id = #{record.receivableId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE crm_receivable SET received_amount = #{record.receivedAmount}, outstanding_amount = #{record.outstandingAmount}, received_date = #{record.receivedDate}, status = #{record.status}, invoice_id = #{record.invoiceId}, invoice_status = #{record.invoiceStatus}, remark = #{record.remark}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} WHERE receivable_id = #{record.receivableId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE crm_receivable SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime} WHERE receivable_id = #{record.receivableId} AND tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.receivable_id, t.tenant_id, t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.contract_id, t.contract_no, t.receivable_no, t.receivable_name, t.planned_amount, t.received_amount, t.outstanding_amount, t.due_date, t.received_date, t.invoice_status, t.invoice_id, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.remark, t.status, t.deleted, t.version, , t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, c.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, c.owner_id AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_receivable t INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND c.deleted = '0' WHERE t.receivable_id = #{receivableId} AND t.deleted = '0'
